Character is a Tide-Shell Crab: squat formidable river crab with a broad dark turquoise lacquer-like ridged carapace, old-gold scalloped shell edging and pale ivory barnacles, cream segmented underside, eight short articulated walking legs, two strong pincers with ivory tips, two expressive amber eyes. Premium hand-painted JRPG illustration, crisp dark contour, textured shell, beautiful painterly lighting, coherent anatomical joints, matches elegant hand-painted Chinese fantasy warrior sprites. Last pose returns to first. No walking out of cell.
